name: Buttermilk
about: Real on-mountain facilities, researched for the 3D scenes. Lifts are keyed by OSM way id (same as data/buttermilk.json). Coordinates are local metres (x east, z south) from the same origin. 'verified': false marks anything not confirmed by a lift database, the resort or a photo; colours are read from dated photos and are approximate hex.
notes: Five Trees and the unnamed rope tow fall inside both the Highlands and Buttermilk boxes.

1212154522.name: Five Trees
1212154522.note: Private lift for the Five Trees homes between Highlands and Buttermilk; not open to the public.

1211521065.name: Lift
1211521065.note: Unnamed rope tow in OSM between Highlands and Buttermilk; appears in both resorts' data. Not identified.

40233630.name: Panda Peak
40233630.note: Beginner double at the base; OSM has no seat count.

40233623.name: Ski School Lift
40233623.note: OSM drag_lift; skiresort.info lists a 'Ski School Tow' baby lift.

99948700.name: Summit Express
99948700.note: Main lift to the Cliffhouse at the top.

99948697.name: West Buttermilk Express
99948697.note: Beginner terrain on the west side; has a mid-station.

buildings.name: Cliffhouse
buildings.style: Cabin-style restaurant at the top of Summit Express: dark green board-and-batten walls, white trim, red door and red sign, gabled roof, Pyramid Peak view.
buildings.position_note: OSM has no Cliffhouse feature; placed at the Summit Express top from data/buttermilk.json.

buildings.name: Buttermilk Mountain Lodge (formerly Bumps)
buildings.style: Base lodge renovated and renamed in 2022/23: tall glass walls and a timber-beam ceiling inside; a new guest services building beside it.
buildings.position_note: At the baked 'Buttermilk Base' place (Summit Express bottom); footprint not in OSM.

buildings.name: Tiehack base
buildings.style: Smaller base at the bottom of Tiehack Express.

signature.name: Cliffhouse
signature.description: Green cabin with a red door at the summit, facing Pyramid Peak.
signature.kit_note: warming_hut painted green with a red door.

signature.name: X Games venue
signature.description: Buttermilk hosts the Winter X Games: superpipe and slopestyle course on the front side.
signature.kit_note: Seasonal; park features (kicker, rails, pipe) are P2 in the kit. Position not in our data.
